caption: The drawing depicts a tall, cylindrical stoneware jar that tapers slightly toward the base and has a flared rim. The jar is mostly gray in color with slight dark speckling. It features two small, looped handles positioned on opposite sides near the upper part of the body. On the center front surface of the jar, there is a cobalt blue painted design of a stylized rooster facing to the right, with prominent tail feathers flowing back and a simple depiction of legs and feet. The interior of the jar is shown with a brownish hue. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. A signature appears in the lower left corner, reading “C.E.G. A. Loughridge.”
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
